Class H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.database.H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper
public final class H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper extends Object

H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper

Stateless analytical physics, demography, surface geometry, snapshot cloning, and Data-Oriented Design (DOD) component helper for H3Cell.
Extracted from H3Cell to enforce the Single Responsibility Principle and keep the JPA entity concise.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    calculateAnnualMetabolicNeedGJ(H3Cell cell)
    Calculates the total annual metabolic subsistence energy required by the cell's population in $\text{GJ/year}$: $$E_{\text{metabolic}} = \left(\sum_{c=0}^{6} N_c \cdot e_c\right) \cdot \mu_{\text{PAL}}(K/N, T) \cdot \mu_{\text{species}}$$
    static double
    calculateDynamicAlbedo(H3Cell cell)
    Calculates dynamic surface albedo $\alpha \in [0.06, 0.85]$ based on snow/ice cover, biome, and natural vegetation density: $$\alpha = \alpha_{\text{biome}} \cdot v_{\text{veg}} + 0.30 \cdot (1 - v_{\text{veg}})$$
    static double
    calculateMovementFriction(H3Cell cell, double techLevel)
    Calculates terrain movement friction (cost-distance multiplier) based on elevation, biome, and technology level: $$f_{\text{move}} = \max\left(0.3, f_{\text{base}}(\text{elev}, \text{biome}) \cdot \max(0.2, 1.0 - 0.08 \cdot T)\right)$$

  • Method Details

    • calculateMovementFriction

      public static double calculateMovementFriction(H3Cell cell, double techLevel)
      Calculates terrain movement friction (cost-distance multiplier) based on elevation, biome, and technology level: $$f_{\text{move}} = \max\left(0.3, f_{\text{base}}(\text{elev}, \text{biome}) \cdot \max(0.2, 1.0 - 0.08 \cdot T)\right)$$
      Parameters:
      cell - target H3 cell
      techLevel - technology level ($1.0$ = ancient, $10.0$ = modern)
      Returns:
      movement friction multiplier ($1.0$ = flat plain, $>10.0$ = extreme mountain/desert/swamp)

    • calculateDynamicAlbedo

      public static double calculateDynamicAlbedo(H3Cell cell)
      Calculates dynamic surface albedo $\alpha \in [0.06, 0.85]$ based on snow/ice cover, biome, and natural vegetation density: $$\alpha = \alpha_{\text{biome}} \cdot v_{\text{veg}} + 0.30 \cdot (1 - v_{\text{veg}})$$
      Parameters:
      cell - target H3 cell
      Returns:
      updated surface albedo $\alpha$

      public static double calculateAnnualMetabolicNeedGJ(H3Cell cell)
      Calculates the total annual metabolic subsistence energy required by the cell's population in $\text{GJ/year}$: $$E_{\text{metabolic}} = \left(\sum_{c=0}^{6} N_c \cdot e_c\right) \cdot \mu_{\text{PAL}}(K/N, T) \cdot \mu_{\text{species}}$$

    • getEffectiveSurfaceAreaKm2

      public static double getEffectiveSurfaceAreaKm2(H3Cell cell)
      Calculates the effective 3D real surface area of the cell in $\text{km}^2$, accounting for embedded H3 resolution and topographical slope expansion: $$A_{3\text{D}} = A_{\text{H3}}(r) \cdot \sqrt{1 + 0.15 \cdot \max(0, f_{\text{move}} - 1)^{1.8}}$$
      Parameters:
      cell - target H3 cell
      Returns:
      effective 3D surface area in $\text{km}^2$
